stories.h: Sea-Tac flights recovering after nationwide FAA ground stop
stories.s: Friday's four-hour FAA ground stop left Sea-Tac with 132 canceled departures Saturday; by Sunday morning cancellations fell to 27, and airlines expected full schedules by Sunday's end.

stories.h: Orcas Island ferry terminal lifts vehicle restrictions
stories.s: WSF restored normal loading at Orcas after repairing cracked transfer-span beams that had limited vehicles since Nov. 10 and prompted a San Juan County emergency. Drivers must use the span's east side for several days.

stories.h: Storm exits; cooler, mostly dry week ahead in western WA
stories.s: After Saturday night's heavy rain, Monday dries out with highs in the low 50s and lows in the 30s. A flood warning for the Skokomish River in Mason County runs until late Monday morning.

stories.h: Report: WA college ROI strong, but career coaching lags
stories.s: A Strada report gives Washington a 73% positive return-on-investment rating for higher education. Only 3% of four-year and 7% of two-year students get complete career coaching.

talking.h: Seahawks dominate second half, beat Raiders 21-13
talking.s: Drew Lock threw two touchdowns and Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 171 receiving yards as Seattle sacked rookie Fernando Mendoza six times and improved to 6-4.

talking.h: Huskies clinch bowl bid despite ground-stop travel chaos
talking.s: UW beat Michigan State 21-14 on a late Jayden Limar touchdown, reaching 6-4 after the FAA ground stop left the team arriving about 15 hours before kickoff.

coming.h: Candlelight vigil for fallen Spokane County deputies
coming.s: A community vigil for deputies Mason Acheson and Parker Perry is set for 7 p.m. at the Law Enforcement Memorial Monument on W. Mallon Ave., Spokane.

coming.h: Memorial service for two Spokane County deputies
coming.s: A public memorial for the deputies killed in the Nov. 3 Spangle shooting will be held at Numerica Veterans Arena; the start time and procession route were still to be announced.
